movie_title.description: Movie title explicitly requested, otherwise null.

genre.description: Requested genre in Vietnamese, otherwise null. Do not infer from a movie title.

date.description: One unambiguous viewing date as YYYY-MM-DD, using the supplied reference date. Otherwise null.

time_range.description: Raw time extraction. Backend normalizes period/approximate expressions and adds bound metadata for consumers.

expression.description: Time phrase from the request. Retain approximate or period wording.

start.description: Explicit lower bound HH:mm. For an exact time, equal to end. Do not invent bounds for periods or approximate times.

end.description: Explicit upper bound HH:mm. May be before start for a range crossing midnight.

text.description: Public area/cinema/brand phrase. For NEARBY or HOME, null; never coordinates or a private address.
